analyst_view.overall: Early view: the Istanbul derby, with leaders Galatasaray six points clear of fourth-placed Besiktas. Galatasaray's Rafael Leao (muscle strain) is unlikely to play and Victor Osimhen (knee surgery on 7 November) is a doubt, with reports saying his return could take up to five weeks; Galatasaray also play Aston Villa six days earlier. Besiktas will have Orkun Kokcu back from suspension, and Vlahovic and Trossard are in form under Vincenzo Italiano.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals and I lean lower. Derbies tend to be tighter than these teams' usual games, and Galatasaray could be without both Osimhen and Leao, two of their main scorers, so I expect a two- or three-goal game rather than a shootout.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.0 corners. Besiktas like to keep the ball at home (about 70% in the first half against Genclerbirligi) and Galatasaray have width through Baris Alper Yilmaz and Sallai, so ten looks right.

cards.text: The numbers say 6.9 cards, already a high line that reflects the derby. Galatasaray captain Bardakci was shown a red card after their last derby with Fenerbahce, and Sanchez and Sallai go in one booking from a ban if they stay clean against Samsunspor; I would not go higher until the referee is named.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.9 shots and I lean slightly lower. Without Osimhen and Leao Galatasaray lose their most frequent shooters, and they will have played Aston Villa six days earlier, which tends to make a derby more cautious.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.8 shots on target. In a tighter derby with Galatasaray's front line weakened, I expect fewer clean efforts, so slightly under the number.
